summary: Comprehensive regression testing of Execution Decision Gate features. All 39 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified working correctly with all P0/P1/P2 features including approve/execute semantics separation, alerts API user-state, config API thresholds + feature flag, and observability metrics.
critical_code_review_comments: Approve vs Execute semantics correctly implemented: QUEUED -> APPROVED -> RELEASED state machine
High-risk execute confirmation blocking works correctly - requires execute_confirmation=true for high-risk intents
Alerts API correctly implements user-based state (read_at, acked_at, acked_by per user)
Config API correctly stores thresholds in DB via BrandSetting and supports feature flag execution_decision_gate_enforced
Observability metrics include reject_ratio, override_ratio, stale_decision_attempt_count, unauthorized_action_attempt_count
seed_data_creation: Test intents created via direct DB insertion for testing purposes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Execution Queue Decision Gate features fully tested. All P0/P1/P2 features working. Approve/Execute separation verified. Alerts API user-state verified. Config API thresholds + feature flag verified. Observability metrics verified. Slack Webhook and Binance are MOCKED.

approve_with_reason.evidence: test_approve_without_reason_returns_400 - returns 400 when reason is empty

reject_with_reason.evidence: test_reject_without_reason_returns_400 - returns 400 when reason is empty

detail_ack_blocking.evidence: test_approve_without_read_ack_returns_400 - returns 400 when read_acknowledged is false

unauthorized_override_blocking.evidence: test_override_requires_super_admin - returns 403 when non-super_admin tries override

super_admin_queue_control_blocking.evidence: test_pause_requires_super_admin, test_resume_requires_super_admin, test_clear_requires_super_admin - all return 401/403 for non-super_admin

manual_edit_revalidation.evidence: test_edit_returns_diff - returns 200 with diff and detail_version

auto_refresh_stale_locked_retryable_visi.evidence: UI shows operational_status column with retryable/locked states, stale indicator shows GÜNCEL/STALE

alerts_api_read_ack_user_state.evidence: GET /alerts returns status, read_at, acked_at, acked_by per user. POST /alerts/{id}/read and /ack work correctly

config_api_thresholds_feature_flag.evidence: GET /config returns execution_decision_gate_enforced and thresholds. PATCH /config updates correctly

observability_metric_contract.evidence: GET /observability returns metrics with reject_ratio, override_ratio, stale_decision_attempt_count, unauthorized_action_attempt_count
